desc: Read input N and S, and collect the 0-indexed positions of all '1's into a list `positions`.
Compute the list `q` where `q[i] = positions[i] - i` for each 1.
Find the median of `q`. If k is odd, the median is `q[k//2]`; if even, any value between `q[k//2 - 1]` and `q[k//2]` works, so we can use `q[k//2]`.
Calculate the total cost as the sum of `abs(q[i] - median)` for all i.
